name: Yamaha XJ650 Seca Turbo
engine: 653 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, turbocharged, carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's early-80s turbo bike. A blow-through carb setup, a turbo to inspect and shaft drive.

H: The turbo is oiled by the engine. Check the feed and return lines and change the oil before the first start.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
